title: DELETE
definition: An HTTP method used to delete the specified resource from the server.
simpleExplanation: Exactly what it sounds like. You tell the server an ID, and the server destroys it.
realWorldExample: A user clicks the trash can icon next to a comment they wrote. The client sends `DELETE /api/comments/123`. The server removes it from the database.

basic: Should a DELETE request have a Request Body?
intermediate: What HTTP Status code should a server return after successfully deleting a resource?

answers.question: Have a body?
answers.answer: Generally, no. The URL itself should contain all the information needed (e.g., the ID of the item to delete). Sending a body with a DELETE request is highly discouraged.

answers.question: Which status code?
answers.answer: `200 OK` (if you want to return a JSON message), or `204 No Content` (if you deleted it and have absolutely nothing else to say to the client).
